shared_elements: low-relief carving with figures on a plain ground
patterned/textured surface detail (scales, garment folds, fringes)
procession-like alignment of figures on a groundline
justification: Both show low-relief profile human figures on a plain ground with careful patterned detailing of hair/beard and garments, and in each case a figure carries a small handled object, which is a moderately specific correspondence. However, A is a single frontal-bodied hybrid figure (fish-cloak/scaled being) with raised arm filling a tall vertical panel, while B is a horizontal processional frieze of camels led by attendants, framed above and below by bands of rosettes — a motif and compositional scheme entirely absent from A.
